title: How to choose the right widget size for your bench
description: A practical guide to sizing a modular widget for a small workshop bench: load, reach, clamping width and the space you need around it.
h1: How to choose the right widget size for your bench
body: Start from the heaviest part you clamp every week, not from the bench size.
A widget that is too wide for the bench blocks the vice; one that is too narrow wobbles under load.
Measure the reach you need, then add the width of the clamping jaws.
